name: inventory_pagination
summary: Add cursor pagination to the inventory API, page through it in the report, and document the new contract
agent_instructions:
This repository contains a small read-only inventory catalog in inventory/api.py with an EXISTING, currently-passing test suite in test_inventory.py. Do NOT delete, rewrite, or gut test_inventory.py's existing tests: keep them passing, and update only the ones the signature change genuinely breaks, saying why in the test (a comment or the commit message). Do NOT rewrite inventory/api.py from scratch; change it in place.

BUG REPORT: report.count_all() in inventory/report.py returns the wrong total. It calls api.list_items() once, and list_items() only ever returns the first `limit` records, so count_all() silently under-counts any catalog larger than one page (the catalog has 250 records).

TASK: give the API real cursor pagination and make the report use it.

1. inventory/api.py - change list_items to:
     list_items(cursor=None, limit=50) -> (items, next_cursor)
   - `limit` is clamped to at most 100 (a caller asking for 101 or 500 gets 100).
   - `limit` less than 1 raises ValueError.
   - `cursor` is None for the first page. A cursor that is unknown or malformed raises ValueError.
   - `next_cursor` is None on the last page; otherwise it is an opaque cursor for the next page.
   - Pages must be disjoint and in catalog order: walking the cursors returns every record exactly once.
2. inventory/report.py - update count_all() to page through every item using the new signature and return the true total (250 for the shipped catalog).
3. README.md - document the new list_items signature and the cursor contract (clamping, ValueError cases, next_cursor None on the last page).
4. test_inventory.py - keep the existing tests green (update only the ones the signature change genuinely breaks, saying why) and add tests for the new contract.

Follow the standard workflow: read the existing code end-to-end, reproduce the under-count with a concrete assertion, then make the minimal change. Do not add unrelated functionality or refactor code you don't need to touch. All tests in test_inventory.py must pass when you are done.
